additional_info.subject: RE: ID0431088-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / S0 170004165] PowerConverter E17 CRM:02681000325
additional_info.body:
Hello Simen,
Greetings of the day!
Following are the error flags occurred:
1.Please check if the power converter are properly connection to its shelf case.
2. Check for any loose connection of any power cable or CAN communication cables of the converter and measured the voltage across it with the help of multimeter. Check the resistance across CAN communication cables.
3. Please see to the display of the power converter whether it is OFF state or ON?
4. If all the steps are performed and you still see the power converter is faulty, we suggest you to replace it.
Attached KA for your reference:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_Sicharge_D_Converter_ Missing converter in DC1,DC2,DC3,DC4 - (dynamics.com)
Do let us know if you have any other queries?
Thank you
Best Regards
